newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu at 7,038 to dollar on March 25 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu at 7,038 to dollar on March 25 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Tuesday it had calculated the exchange rate of the leu at 7,038 to the dollar for March 25.
On Monday the BNR calculated the leu at 7,011 to the dollar.

The rate, which is not compulsory for book-keeping operations or inter-bank deals, would be used by the Finance Ministry, customs authorities, prosecutor's office and the police as well as for statistical purposes.
The announced rate is based on prices quoted by commercial banks operating in Romania's foreign exchange market.
